name: Kitchen Terminal K7
description: Retro-futurist amber-phosphor HUD for a wall-mounted kitchen kiosk. Monospace, zero radius, no shadows, three luminance modes, built to a Safari 15.0 / iPad Air 2 baseline.

source.origin: handoff-1.zip — HANDOFF.md, TECH-STACK.md, PLAN.md, theme.schema.yaml, layout.schema.yaml, wireframes/01-06

target.deployment: LAN, PWA via Add to Home Screen, Auto-Lock Never

exemptions: display-body-type-pairing — a single monospace family is required by the brief and correct for a data-dense instrument
